# dsh-live-studio

> A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for Bilibili live chat, text-to-speech replies, agent-controlled Live2D expressions and motions, and browser-source streaming.

DeepSeek Harness plugin documentation. Capabilities and installation limits are version-specific; consult the README and release notes.

## Documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XiaoZheBrother/dsh-live-studio/main/README.md): Chinese overview, capabilities, dependencies, screenshots, installation and limitations.
- [Agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XiaoZheBrother/dsh-live-studio/main/docs/agent-guide.md): Entry points, minimal configuration, tool parameters, results and completion checks.
- [Package metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XiaoZheBrother/dsh-live-studio/main/package.json): Current source version and dependency declarations.
- [Releases](https://github.com/XiaoZheBrother/dsh-live-studio/releases): Published packages; source and release capabilities may differ.
- [Issues](https://github.com/XiaoZheBrother/dsh-live-studio/issues): Report reproducible problems.
